Necessary large images, music, sounds or videos are versioned as long as they're under what GitHub accepts for a file; a required file over that stays out of git and is documented as missing in a versioned doc. Don't add any output file: put those in .gitignore. Before adding anything, make sure no API key or secret is going to be versioned, nor any other personal information. Expand the main README to explain what this project is, for humans; documentation for AI agents can go in docs/.
Call the repository night-signals-title-card. And for the commits use 1234567+nightsignals@users.noreply.github.com, just in this repository.
